pattern.description: Regular expression pattern to search for

path.description: Directory or file to search (relative to workspace, default: .)

include.description: Glob patterns for files to include (e.g., ['*.rs', '*.ts'])

exclude.description: Glob patterns for files to exclude (e.g., ['*.min.js', 'node_modules/*'])

context_lines.description: Number of context lines before and after each match (default: 2)

case_insensitive.description: Whether to perform case-insensitive matching (default: false)

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 100)

symbol_index.description: Also query the symbol index for definitions matching the pattern (default: false). Symbol line numbers may drift for macro-expanded code.

symbol_kind.description: Filter symbol hits by kind, e.g. "fn", "struct", "interface", "type", "enum", "const", "trait", "trait_fn", "impl_fn", "class", "method".

respect_gitignore.description: When true (default), honor .gitignore / .ignore and parent ignore files; also skips target/, node_modules/, etc. Set false to search ignored paths (like rg -uuu).

output_mode.description: content: matching lines with context (default). files_with_matches: file paths only (saves tokens). count: per-file match counts.
